svg.title: White Relief Over White
svg.desc: Interpretive study from a visually inspected primary gallery photograph. Approximate geometry and standardized vivid palette. Photograph perspective, shadows and texture omitted. Neutral lines show the observed boundaries between white panels; they are guides, not grey paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://matthewmarks.com/exhibitions/ellsworth-kelly-at-ninety-05-2013/lightbox/works/white-relief-over-white-2012-37119; inspected 2026-10-27. This editable vector is a study, not a facsimile.
